plan.title: Plan - GenAI Marketing Tools
plan.description: Research, analyze, and strategize with AI-powered market research, audience intelligence, and competitive analysis tools. These solutions help marketers make data-driven decisions and develop winning strategies.
plan.longDescription: Plan tools sit at the front of the marketing workflow, before a single ad runs. They pull demand signals, audience data, and competitor moves into one place so you can decide where to spend and what to say. The four subcategories cover market research, audience intelligence, competitive analysis, and the AI assistants that tie them together.

create.title: Create - GenAI Marketing Tools
create.description: Generate compelling content with AI-powered creative tools for ads, copy, landing pages, and social media. These tools help marketers produce high-quality content faster and at scale.
create.longDescription: Create tools are where a campaign turns into shippable assets: ad creative, landing page and SEO copy, social posts, and the variations you test them with. They range from lightweight AI writing assistants to full systems that generate and adapt creative across formats, so small teams ship more without a matching jump in headcount.

activate.title: Activate - GenAI Marketing Tools
activate.description: Launch and manage campaigns with AI-powered activation tools for campaign management, email, ad platforms, and personalized shopping experiences. These tools help marketers reach customers efficiently.
activate.longDescription: Activate tools take a finished plan and turn it into a live campaign. They launch ads, send outreach, manage spend, and keep campaigns optimized in market, across campaign management, email and outreach, AI ad platforms, and shopping assistants. The point is to close the gap between strategy and execution, so teams spend their hours on judgment instead of manual work.

measure.title: Measure - GenAI Marketing Tools
measure.description: Track, analyze, and optimize with AI-powered measurement tools for attribution, analytics, and GenAI visibility. These tools help marketers understand performance and make data-driven improvements.
measure.longDescription: Measure tools turn spend, traffic, conversions, and revenue scattered across platforms into something you can act on. Attribution assigns credit across touchpoints, analytics aggregates performance into dashboards, and GenAI visibility tracks how your brand shows up inside AI answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews.

general.title: General - GenAI Marketing Tools
general.description: Versatile AI tools that work across categories and subcategories for specific workflows and broader business applications beyond traditional marketing.
general.longDescription: General tools are the multi-use ones: connectors, agents, and workflow builders that touch Plan, Create, Activate, and Measure rather than specializing in one. They move work between the specialist tools, from no-code automation canvases to AI employees that own a recurring task, plus open-source agents you host yourself.
